title: House of Blues | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Private beach access directly across the street - 400 yards from the sand* 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Spacious wraparound porch on the main level with rocking chairs, plus an upstairs porch off the bedroom, also furnished with rocking chairs
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Private beach access directly across the street - 400 yards from the sand* 4 Fun Pug Bikes* Spacious wraparound porch on the main level with rocking chairs, plus an upstairs porch off the bedroom, also furnished with rocking chairs* Close to the Community Pool* Gulf Fishing Charters and Beach Chair attendants available at Grayton Beach* 1.2 Miles from Grayton Beach State Park* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February. To receive a qualified quote, you must select a minimum of 28 consecutive nights during the months of November through February to receive a special Snowbird rate. Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!House of Blues is located in the beautiful, gated community of The Preserve, just steps from the beach. This professionally decorated 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home features a relaxed Tommy Bahama style with soothing shades of blue, cream, and tan throughout. The home offers numerous upgrades, including custom cabinetry, granite countertops, top-of-the-line appliances, and comfortable, high-quality beds. Thoughtful details such as double vanities in select bathrooms, rocking chairs, and ceiling fans on both porches, and tasteful coastal décor create a welcoming and upscale retreat. Situated directly across the street from the community’s private beach boardwalk, you’ll enjoy easy access to the sugar-white sand and beautiful Gulf waters.The home features two spacious levels:Main Level:The open-concept kitchen is perfect for entertaining, with seating for six at the dining table and four additional seats at the breakfast bar. The living room includes a 65-inch Smart TV and DVD player for relaxing evenings. The primary suite on this level offers a king-size bed and a spacious private bathroom. A second bedroom features two sets of bunk beds—ideal for younger guests.Second Level:Upstairs, you’ll find an additional primary suite with a king-size bed and a private bathroom. The fourth bedroom includes two queen beds, offering plenty of space for family and friends.With a state forest located just behind the home, you’ll enjoy exceptional privacy and peaceful surroundings. The Preserve is a quiet, gated neighborhood offering two community pools, tennis courts, and a fitness center. Come experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm—and start making lasting memories at House of Blues.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds* Beach wagon and assorted beach toys are typically provided; however, inventory is not guaranteedGrayton Beach is a laid-back, organic beach town with old-style wooden beach bungalows and narrow neighborhood streets lined with live oaks. You'll also get a “hippie kitsch” feel, having the iconic Red Bar a stroll away. Take the neighborhood boardwalk to the beach or hop on the bikes and head 2.4 miles to explore Seaside. This cool little beach town is also home to the diverse coastal ecosystems of Western Lake and Grayton Beach State Park and is a gateway to a large expanse of sugar-white beach that is a haven for fishermen, boaters, and beachcombers alike.AREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and incredible architecture that make 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, but it also provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here!Enjoy this Funky, Free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. You’ll enjoy the many shopping and dining options, such as ‘Another Broken Egg’. This is much more than a cool beach town; this location is the best of both worlds. Enjoy a quiet, relaxing getaway while still having a lot of action-packed activities at your fingertips. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
